title: Adversarial Robustness of Kernel Machines: A Comprehensive Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2611.07474v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Kernel machines are an important class of models in machine learning. However, the question of how robust modern kernel machines are to adversarial examples has not been studied comprehensively. In this paper, we provide a thorough empirical investigation of the adversarial robustness of kernel-based models for both binary and multiclass classification tasks, via white-box and black-box evasion attacks. We evaluate the native robustness of kernel machines, random feature classifiers, and the relatively newer Recursive Feature Machines. In addition, we provide an algorithm for approximate adversarial training of kernel machines. Our experiments on classification tasks on image and tabular datasets strongly indicate that kernel machines are natively more robust than neural networks, i.e., their performance degrades more gracefully against adversarial perturbations.

translated_title: 核机器的对抗鲁棒性：一项全面分析
translated_abstract: 核机器是机器学习中一类重要的模型。然而，现代核机器对对抗样本的鲁棒性问题尚未得到全面研究。在本文中，我们通过白盒和黑盒逃避攻击，对基于核的模型在二分类和多分类任务中的对抗鲁棒性进行了深入的实证研究。我们评估了核机器、随机特征分类器以及相对较新的递归特征机器的固有鲁棒性。此外，我们提出了一种用于核机器近似对抗训练的算法。我们在图像和表格数据集分类任务上的实验有力地表明，核机器天生比神经网络更鲁棒，即在面对对抗扰动时其性能下降更为平缓。
tldr: 本文通过白盒和黑盒攻击全面评估了核机器的对抗鲁棒性，发现核机器天生比神经网络更鲁棒，并提出了一种核机器的近似对抗训练算法。
en_tdlr: This paper comprehensively evaluates the adversarial robustness of kernel machines via white-box and black-box attacks, showing that kernel machines are natively more robust than neural networks, and proposes an approximate adversarial training algorithm for kernel machines.
